gain_definition: LARPModel.increment multiplied by scalar gain, inside the unchanged h += 0.1 * increment; includes base and adapter; no extra trainable parameter
inputs: exact previously frozen v1 local/remote cases; both source bits remain present with original source/query IDs
gate_split: both train and validation final, finite
order: Grid-local: target then gain then seed; MHU-local only after Grid copy gate; remote: geometry then target then gain then seed after common copy gate
grid_gate: at least one fixed gain obtains b0 train and validation >=0.98 in both seeds
remote_gate: at least one common fixed gain obtains b0 train and validation >=0.98 for both geometries and both seeds
gates_are_not_gain_selection: if remote gate opens, run both gains and both targets; no HPO or adopted scientific architecture
incomplete_runs: preserve partial state; remaining NOT_RUN; no retry or budget extension
